This schema maps directly to the 'todo_app_users' table and related token information used by the authentication system. Sensitive information such as passwords or password hashes are strictly excluded for security.

Consistent with security principles, the user ID is provided as a UUID string, and the token property references the reusable IAuthorizationToken schema representing JWT tokens.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user corresponding to the 'id' column in the todo_app_users table, representing the primary key as a UUID.

email.description: Email address of the user used for login and communication.

username.description: Username selected by the user for personalized identification.

created_at.description: Timestamp marking when the user was created in the system, following ISO 8601 standards.

updated_at.description: Timestamp indicating the last update time of the user record. Null means no updates have occurred since creation.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp marking when the user was soft-deleted. Null indicates the user is active.

accessTokens.description: List of access tokens issued to the user for authentication and session management.

refreshTokens.description: List of refresh tokens associated with the user enabling session renewal.

emailVerifications.description: Records of email verification attempts and statuses linked to the user.

userPasswordResets.description: Password reset requests submitted by the user for account recovery.

userRoles.description: User roles assigned defining access permissions within the application.

sessions.description: Active and historical user sessions tracking authentication state and device information.

todoItems.description: Collection of todo items created and owned exclusively by the user.

auditLogs.description: Audit log entries recording create, update, and delete actions performed by the user on todo items.

ITodoAppGuest.IAuthorized.description:
Response DTO representing an authorized guest user with credentials for authenticated session access.

Provides the guest unique identifier and authorization JWT token required for session management in the system.

Used in guest user registration and token refresh endpoints, supporting secure stateless authentication for temporary users.

id.description: Unique identifier for the guest user in the system, mapped to the 'id' column in the 'todo_app_guests' table, used to identify the authorized guest session uniquely.

guestIdentifier.description: Unique string identifier assigned to the guest user for session tracking and validation. This replaces session identifiers to align with database schema.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the guest record was created in the system.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last guest record update. Nullable when no updates have been made.

deletedAt.description: Timestamp when the guest record was soft-deleted. Nullable if the record is active.

ITodoAppGuest.description: Represents a guest user entity in the TodoApp system, storing unauthenticated user information identified by the guest identifier. This entity maintains metadata for lifecycle tracking within the system's guest management context.

id.description: Unique identifier for the guest user record.

guestIdentifier.description: Unique string identifier assigned to the guest user for session tracking and validation. This replaces session identifiers to align with database schema.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the guest record was created in the system.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last guest record update. Nullable when no updates have been made.

deletedAt.description: Timestamp when the guest record was soft-deleted. Nullable if the record is active.

ITodoAppConfiguration.description:
Entity representing configuration settings in the todoApp system.

Each record corresponds to a configuration entry controlling system parameters and application behavior.

The entity is used for retrieving, creating, and updating configuration data via authenticated user operations in the API.

This representation maps precisely to the todo_app_configurations table in the database schema, ensuring full alignment.

All fields are included with detailed descriptions following the database column documentation standards.

id.description: Unique identifier for the configuration record.

key.description: Unique key identifying the configuration parameter.

value.description: Value associated with the configuration parameter.

description.description: Detailed description of the configuration parameter, explaining its purpose and usage. Nullable to allow for configurations that omit descriptions.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the configuration record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp indicating the last update time of the record.

type.description: Type category of the configuration entry to classify its purpose within the system.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp marking when the configuration was deleted, if applicable; null otherwise.

ITodoAppSecurityPolicy.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for searching and paginating TodoApp security policies.

This type is a request DTO specifying filter criteria, sorting options, and pagination controls for listing security policies in the todoApp system. It facilitates dynamic querying of security policies by authorized users in a secure and controlled manner.

It is not a database entity representation but an input parameter schema for API filtering operations.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting from 1. Controls which page of results to retrieve.

limit.description: Number of items per page for pagination. Defines how many policies are included in one response page.

search.description: Full-text search keyword applied to policy name and description fields. Allows filtering policies matching the search term.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort the results by. Typically corresponds to a column like 'name', 'created_at', or other policy attributes.

oneOf.description: Sort direction: 'asc' for ascending order or 'desc' for descending order.
Sort direction: 'asc' for ascending order or 'desc' for descending order.

sortOrder.description: Sort direction: 'asc' for ascending order or 'desc' for descending order.

ITodoAppSecurityPolicy.description:
Represents a security policy entity in the todoApp system, defining access control rules and permissions that govern user behavior and system resources. This entity is central to managing security configurations, enforcing policy-based access control.

Each policy entry includes identifiers, descriptive metadata, a JSON string defining permissions, active status, and timestamps for auditing.

Used in create, retrieve, and update operations requiring authenticated user context.

id.description: Unique identifier for the security policy record in UUID format.

key.description: Unique key name of the security policy used for identification and referencing within the system.

value.description: JSON string containing key-value pairs representing detailed permission settings associated with this security policy. Defines granular access control rules.

description.description: Detailed description of the security policy, outlining its purpose, scope, and specific rules applying to it. Nullable if no description has been provided.

active.description: Flag indicating whether the security policy is currently active and enforced. Allows for deactivating policies without deletion.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the policy was created. Auto-generated by the system to facilitate auditing and change tracking.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to the policy. Nullable if no updates have been made since creation.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp indicating soft deletion of the policy. Null if the policy is active.

ITodoAppRefreshToken.ICreate.description:
Request DTO for creating a new refresh token in the todoApp system. This schema defines the properties required to create a record in the 'todo_app_refresh_tokens' database table, excluding system-managed and auto-generated fields.

It includes the refresh token string, expiration timestamp, and optional user and session associations while respecting security constraints that injection of authenticated user identity is handled server-side.

This DTO is used in API operations where authenticated 'user' or 'guest' actors request a new refresh token to maintain session continuity securely.

refresh_token.description: The secure refresh token string used for authentication sessions. Must be unique and randomly generated to prevent token prediction or duplication attacks.

user_id.description: Optional identifier of the user associated with this refresh token. Nullable because the token can also belong to guests or be unaffiliated with a user session.

user_session_id.description: Optional identifier of the user session associated with this refresh token. Nullable to allow for tokens that are not tied to sessions explicitly.

expired_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the refresh token expires, after which it is invalid for authentication renewal. Must be formatted as an ISO 8601 date-time string in UTC.

ITodoAppUser.IRefresh.description:
Request DTO for refreshing the JWT access token for an authenticated member user. Contains the refresh token string used to obtain a new access token. This DTO maps directly to the todo_app_refresh_tokens table storing the refresh tokens issued to users.

Security Note: User authentication context is derived from the bearer token/session and not included in this DTO.

Clients must supply a valid refresh token string for access token renewal.

refresh_token.description: JWT refresh token string issued to the user. Must be presented in a valid format for token renewal processes.

ITodoAppConfiguration.ICreate.description: Request DTO for creating a new configuration record in the todo app system. This schema includes non-generated fields required to create a configuration entry, excluding system fields and sensitive data. Used in POST /todoApp/user/configurations endpoint with user authorization.

key.description: A unique key to identify the configuration parameter. Must be unique across all configuration entries.

value.description: The value associated with the configuration key. Represents the setting or parameter value stored as a string.

description.description: An optional human-readable description detailing the purpose or usage of this configuration setting. This field can be null if no description is provided.

type.description: The type of configuration setting. Indicates the kind or category of the configuration (e.g., 'boolean', 'string', 'number'). This helps to interpret the value field appropriately.

ITodoAppGuest.IUpdate.description: Partial update DTO for a guest user in the todo_app_guests table. Allows updating the guest_identifier which uniquely identifies the guest within the system. All properties are optional to support partial updates. Identity, timestamps, and relations are managed server-side and excluded from this request body.

guest_identifier.description: Unique identifier string for the guest user used within the system to distinguish guests.

ITodoAppSecurityPolicy.ISummary.description: Summary view of a todoApp security policy entity providing key identifying and descriptive fields necessary for listings and administrative overviews while excluding sensitive or detailed configuration.

id.description: The unique identifier for the security policy record. This is a UUID string that uniquely identifies each policy in the system. Nullable if not yet assigned.

key.description: The unique key representing the security policy, used for concise identification and reference within the system.

value.description: The descriptive value or name of the security policy, used for display and administrative identification purposes.

description.description: Detailed textual explanation of the security policy's purpose, rules, and attributes. Nullable to allow policies without descriptions.

active.description: Indicates whether the security policy is currently active and enforced within the system.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the security policy was created in ISO 8601 format, used for auditing and sorting.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the security policy was last updated in ISO 8601 format, useful for change tracking and version control.

ITodoAppUser.ILogin.description: Request DTO for user login operation in the todoApp system. Contains the user's email and plaintext password for authentication, along with session context fields such as the request origin URL (href), referrer URL, and optional IP address. This information is used to authenticate registered users securely and establish an authenticated session.

email.description: The email address of the user attempting to log in. Must be a valid, registered email in the system.

password.description: The plain text password entered by the user. This field is mapped to the database's password_hash column but transmitted as plaintext for authentication purposes.

ip.description: Optional IP address from which the login request originates. Can be null if not provided.

href.description: The current URL where the login request is made. Required to provide session context and enable audit tracking.

referrer.description: The referrer URL indicating the previous page before the login. Required for session auditing and context estimation.

ITodoAppConfiguration.IUpdate.description:
Request DTO for updating a configuration record in the todo_app_configurations table of the todoApp system.

This schema defines the mutable fields that clients can provide to update specific configuration entries. It excludes all system-managed fields such as IDs and timestamps.

Clients must be authenticated as 'user' actors to perform this operation, so user identity fields are omitted as they are injected by the backend from the authenticated session context.

All properties are optional, consistent with update semantics allowing partial updates.

Each property is documented with detailed information matching the corresponding database schema column comments.

key.description: The configuration key name used to identify the configuration entry in the system.

value.description: The value associated with the configuration key, stored as a string.

description.description: An optional descriptive text providing details or purpose of the configuration setting. This property is nullable in the database schema and therefore allows null values to avoid runtime errors.

updated_at.description: The timestamp marking when this configuration entry was last updated. Nullable to handle records where update time is unset.

ITodoAppConfiguration.ISummary.description: Summary view of a todoApp configuration representing key configuration data stored in the todo_app_configurations table for efficient listing and display in API responses.

id.description: Unique identifier for the configuration entry.

key.description: Configuration key name uniquely identifying the setting.

value.description: Configuration value associated with the key for this entry.

type.description: The type or category of the configuration, optional and may be null.

description.description: Description providing additional information about the configuration entry, optional and may be null.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this configuration entry was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this configuration entry was last updated. Null indicates no updates since creation.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when this configuration entry was deleted. Null indicates the entry is active.

ITodoAppAccessToken.IRequest.description:
Search and filter criteria for listing todoApp access tokens.

This request DTO defines optional filter properties that clients can use to query access tokens, including filtering by user association, token validity, expiration dates, and token type. It supports pagination and flexible querying for access tokens stored in the system.

user_id.description: Identifier of the user associated with the access token. This allows filtering the access tokens belonging to a specific user.

token.description: Access token string used for authentication. This filter allows searching for tokens matching a specific token string value.

expired_at_before.description: Filter to include tokens that expire before this date and time. Useful to find tokens that are nearing expiration or already expired.

expired_at_after.description: Filter to include tokens that expire after this date and time. Useful to find tokens that are valid beyond a certain point in time.

created_at_before.description: Filter to include tokens created before this date and time. Helps to query tokens issued before a certain moment.

created_at_after.description: Filter to include tokens created after this date and time. Enables searching for freshly created tokens within a time range.

revoked.description: Filter tokens by their revocation status. Set to true to include only revoked tokens, or false to include only active (not revoked) tokens.

token_type.description: Type of the access token. Allows filtering tokens by their designated type (e.g., "access", "refresh").

ITodoAppRole.IRequest.description: Request DTO for filtering and paginating todoApp roles in the system. Supports search filters and pagination options, ensuring authenticated users can efficiently browse role data.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Indicates which page of results to retrieve. Must be a positive integer.

limit.description: Number of records per page. Sets the maximum number of role records returned in the response.

searchTerm.description: Optional search term to filter roles by name or description. Supports partial match searches for efficient filtering.

roleType.description: Optional filter by role type category. Enables narrowing results to specific role classifications.

ITodoAppAccessToken.ICreate.description: Request DTO for creating a new access token in todoApp system, representing required token issuance data excluding system-generated fields.

token.description: The access token string granted to the client for authentication.

type.description: Type of the token, e.g., bearer, to denote usage semantics.

issued_at.description: Timestamp when the token was issued in ISO 8601 format.

expired_at.description: Timestamp when the token expires in ISO 8601 format.

revoked_at.description: Timestamp when the token was revoked; null if the token is active.

todo_app_user_id.description: User ID associated with this token; nullable in case token relates to guest or session.

todo_app_guest_id.description: Guest ID associated with this token; nullable when related to user or session.

todo_app_user_session_id.description: User session ID for the token's ownership context; nullable if token relates directly to user or guest.

ITodoAppSecurityPolicy.ICreate.description: Request DTO for creating a new security policy in the todoApp system. It includes all necessary fields to define the policy's key, value, optional description, and active status. System-managed fields and authentication context are excluded to ensure secure and consistent policy creation.

key.description: Unique key identifying the security policy. Used internally to reference the specific rule within the system.

value.description: The value associated with the security policy key, specifying the rule's effect, parameters, or permission settings.

description.description: Optional detailed explanation of the security policy, outlining the rule's purpose, conditions, and any additional information for auditing or administrative clarity.

active.description: Indicates whether the security policy is currently active and enforced within the system.

ITodoAppGuest.IRequest.description:
Search and pagination parameters for filtering and retrieving guest users in the todoApp system.

This request object includes optional fields for filtering by guest attributes such as creation timestamp, status, and other guest-related properties. It also supports pagination parameters to control page size and offset for efficient querying of large guest datasets.

Being a request parameter type, this schema is not directly mapped to a database table but corresponds to input filters applied against the `todo_app_guests` table.

Clients use this schema to flexibly search guest users while the backend enforces validation and security constraints.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Specifies which page of guests to retrieve. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

limit.description: Number of guest records to return per page. Controls the size of each page in the paginated result set. Defaults to 20 if not provided.

searchText.description: Free-text search keyword to filter guests based on matching attributes such as name, email, or other guest-related fields.

status.description: Guest user status filter. Allows filtering guests by their current status such as active, inactive, or banned.

createdAfter.description: Filter to include only guests created after this timestamp. Uses ISO 8601 date-time format.

createdBefore.description: Filter to include only guests created before this timestamp. Uses ISO 8601 date-time format.

access.description:
JWT access token for authenticated requests.

This token should be included in the Authorization header for subsequent
authenticated API requests as `Bearer {token}`.

refresh.description:
Refresh token for obtaining new access tokens.

This token can be used to request new access tokens when the current access
token expires, extending the user's session.

expired_at.description:
Access token expiration timestamp.

ISO 8601 date-time string indicating when the access token will expire and
can no longer be used for authentication.

refreshable_until.description:
Refresh token expiration timestamp.

ISO 8601 date-time string indicating the latest time until which the
refresh token can be used to obtain new access tokens.

token.description: The token string representing the access credentials.

type.description: The type of the access token, such as bearer.

issued_at.description: The timestamp when the token was issued.

revoked_at.description: The timestamp when the token was revoked, or null if not revoked.

todo_app_user_id.description: Foreign key to the user who owns this token.

todo_app_guest_id.description: Foreign key to the guest who owns this token.

todo_app_user_session_id.description: Foreign key to the user session associated with this token.

ITodoAppAccessToken.description:
Authorization token response structure.

This interface defines the structure of the authorization token response
returned after successful user authentication. It contains both access and
refresh tokens along with their expiration information.

This token structure is automatically included in API schemas when the system
detects authorization actors in the requirements analysis phase. It provides
a standard format for JWT-based authentication across the generated backend
applications.

ITodoAppRole.description: A user role entity in the todoApp system defining access control and permissions. Represents the todo_app_roles database table structure, used for detailed retrieval and update operations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the role entity. This primary key is used internally to distinguish roles.

role_code.description: Unique business identifier code for the role, globally unique within the todoApp system. This field is mapped to the 'name' column in the database representing the role code.

description.description: A descriptive text providing context and purpose of the role. Useful for administrators to understand the role's intent and permissions.

created_at.description: Timestamp marking the creation date of the role entity. Automatically assigned by the system and immutable.

updated_at.description: Timestamp for the last modification of the role entity. Nullable to support roles not yet updated since creation. Used for audit and synchronization.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null if the role is active. Supports soft-delete functionality for the role to maintain historical data.

userRoles.description: Array of user-role bindings associating users with this role. Represents a many-to-many relationship to user entities with this role assignment.

ITodoAppRefreshToken.IRequest.description: Request DTO for refreshing an authentication refresh token associated with an authenticated user. Represents the data required for partial update of the refresh token record in the todo_app_refresh_tokens table, excluding user identity and session ownership fields which are derived automatically from authentication context. Includes token string and expiration details essential for secure token renewal.

id.description: Unique identifier of the refresh token record in the database. This ID is required to accurately locate the refresh token entry during the refresh process.

refresh_token.description: The refresh token string used by the client to authenticate and request a new access token. This must be valid and present to authorize the refresh operation.

expired_at.description: The timestamp at which the refresh token expires. Null indicates the token does not expire. This field is required to manage token validity periods and renewal windows securely.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the refresh token record was initially created in the database. May be null if not recorded. This helps with auditing and token lifecycle management.

ITodoAppUserEmailVerification.IRequest.description: Search and pagination parameters for querying user email verification records in the todo_app_user_email_verifications table. Used by authenticated users to filter and retrieve their email verification records securely and efficiently.

verificationStatus.description: Filter email verification records by their status. Possible values include 'pending', 'verified', or 'expired' indicating the current verification state of the email record.

verificationCode.description: Filter records matching the exact verification code provided during user registration or email verification process.

userId.description: Filter records by the associated user ID to retrieve email verifications specific to a user. Typically, the authenticated user's ID is injected by the server, but this field allows optional filtering by user identifier if needed.

startDate.description: Filter records created at or after this timestamp. Uses ISO 8601 date-time format.

endDate.description: Filter records created at or before this timestamp. Uses ISO 8601 date-time format.

page.description: Page number of the paginated result set to retrieve. Defaults to 1 if not provided. Used to paginate large result sets for efficient data retrieval.

pageSize.description: Number of records per page to retrieve in paginated results. Defaults to 20 if not specified. Supports efficient data browsing and UI display optimization.

ITodoAppConfiguration.IRequest.description: Request parameter DTO for searching and filtering todoApp configuration settings. This object defines optional filters such as configuration keys, values, description text, creation and update timestamp ranges, pagination limits, and sorting options. It supports flexible querying over the 'todo_app_configurations' database table. This DTO does not map to a stored entity but serves as input criteria for configuration searches.

key.description: Configuration key used to filter configuration entries by their unique key identifier.

value.description: Configuration value used to filter configuration entries matching the specified value.

description.description: Optional description content filter to search configuration entries by their descriptive text or notes. Nullable to reflect that the database column is nullable, preventing runtime errors when the value is null.

created_at_from.description: Filter configurations created on or after this timestamp in ISO 8601 date-time format.

created_at_to.description: Filter configurations created on or before this timestamp in ISO 8601 date-time format.

updated_at_from.description: Filter configurations updated on or after this timestamp in ISO 8601 date-time format.

updated_at_to.description: Filter configurations updated on or before this timestamp in ISO 8601 date-time format.

limit.description: Maximum number of configuration entries to return in the response. Controls pagination size.

offset.description: Number of configuration entries to skip in the response, used for pagination offset.

sort_by.description: Field name to sort the configuration entries by, e.g., 'key' or 'created_at'.

oneOf.description: Sort order direction for query results, either 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending.
Sort order direction for query results, either 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending.

sort_order.description: Sort order direction for query results, either 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending.

ITodoAppSecurityPolicy.IUpdate.description:
Request DTO for partial update of security policies in the todo_app_security_policies table.

This DTO supports patching selected security policy fields by authenticated users.

All fields are optional, allowing partial modification of policy attributes.

Authentication context manages actor identity, so no user references are included.

The security policy fields reflect access control settings used in TodoApp platform.

Includes nullable description field and optional system-managed timestamps.

id.description: Unique identifier for the security policy. Auto-generated and immutable; excluded from update requests.

key.description: Key field representing the name of the security policy defining access control rules. Can be updated to rename the policy.

value.description: Value field containing JSON string defining access control rules and restrictions. Can be updated to change the policy's behavior.

description.description: Detailed description of the security policy's purpose and scope. This field is nullable to allow clearing or missing descriptions.

active.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the security policy is active and enforced. Can be updated to enable or disable the policy.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the security policy was created. Managed by the system; can be optionally included but typically set by backend.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of latest update. Managed by system; optionally included for update operations.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp for soft deletion marking. Managed by system; can be optionally included for administrative purposes.

ITodoAppUser.IJoin.description:
Request DTO for user registration (join) operation in the todoApp system.

This schema defines the required fields for new users to create an account, including email, plain text password, and connection session context for audit and security purposes.

System fills actor identity and authentication tokens internally. Passwords are submitted as plain text and hashed server-side.

Includes session metadata (IP, href, referrer) to track connection context at join time.

email.description: User email address used for login and notifications. Must be unique in the system and conform to standard email format.

password.description: Plain text user password for account creation. This is never stored directly but is hashed and saved as password_hash in the database.

ip.description: Optional client IP address at the time of registration. If not provided, server extracts IP from request context. Used for security audit and session records.

href.description: Mandatory URI string of the page URL the client used during registration request. Used for session tracking and auditing.

referrer.description: Mandatory URI string of the HTTP referrer page URL leading to the registration request. Used for session tracking and auditing.

ITodoAppGuest.IRefresh.description: Request DTO for refreshing a guest user's authentication token. This object contains the unique identifier string of the guest refresh token used to validate and renew the guest session.

id.description: Unique identifier of the guest refresh token for authentication renewal. This ID matches the 'id' field in the 'todo_app_guests' database table and serves as the credential for refreshing the guest JWT token.

ITodoAppRole.ISummary.description: Summary representation of a role entity from the todo_app_roles table. Provides essential identification and descriptive information suitable for role overviews and listings without exposing internal system metadata or sensitive data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the role. This UUID is generated by the system and uniquely identifies each role within the todoApp context.

name.description: The name of the role, representing the access level and set of permissions assigned to users. This property uniquely identifies the role within the system.

description.description: A textual description providing additional context about the role's purpose and responsibilities within the application. Helps administrators understand the role's function.

ITodoAppAccessToken.IUpdate.description: Request DTO schema for updating an access token entity in the todoApp system. This schema enables users to update modifiable fields like the token string, expiration timestamp, revoked status, and updated timestamp. User identity fields are excluded as they are supplied from authentication context. Fields strictly conform to the 'todo_app_access_tokens' database schema and exclude immutable or system-managed columns.

token.description: The access token string issued to the user for authenticating requests to the todoApp service.

expired_at.description: The expiration timestamp of the access token, indicating when it becomes invalid. Nullable to allow tokens without explicit expiration time.

revoked_at.description: Indicates whether the access token has been revoked by the user or system. Revoked tokens are no longer accepted.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the access token was last modified. Managed automatically by the system upon update.

ITodoAppUserEmailVerification.description: User email verification entity storing verification tokens, expiration, verification status, and linkage to the user account for the todoApp system.

user.description: Associated user summary information for this verification record. Replaces user_id foreign key scalar field.

id.description: Primary unique identifier of the email verification record.

token.description: Verification token used for confirming user email ownership.

token_expired_at.description: Expiration timestamp for the verification token, after which it becomes invalid.

verified_at.description: Timestamp when the email was verified. Null if verification is pending.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the verification record was created.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete timestamp marking when the record was logically removed. Null if not deleted.

user_id.description: Foreign key UUID linking to the user who owns this email verification record. This key is critical for mapping the relationship in the database.

ITodoAppUserPasswordReset.IRequest.description: Request parameters for searching and paginating user password reset records in the todoApp system. This DTO supports filtering by token, creation and expiration dates, user association, and status flags, along with standard pagination controls to efficiently query password reset requests.

token.description: Password reset token value used for validation and identification of reset requests. Supports partial or full token filtering.

user_id.description: Unique identifier of the user associated with the password reset request. Used to filter reset entries for a specific user.

created_before.description: Filter to include reset requests created before this date/time. Helps narrow the search to older requests.

created_after.description: Filter to include reset requests created after this date/time. Allows focusing on recent requests.

expired.description: Flag indicating whether to include only expired (true) or non-expired (false) password reset tokens. Null to ignore expiration status.

page.description: Page number for paginated results, starting at 1. Used to retrieve specific pages in large result sets.

page_size.description: Number of entries per page in paginated results. Controls the size of the result set returned in each page.

oneOf.description: Sort order direction for results, either ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc'). Controls the order in which results are returned.
Sort order direction for results, either ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc'). Controls the order in which results are returned.

sort_order.description: Sort order direction for results, either ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc'). Controls the order in which results are returned.

sort_by.description: Field name to sort the results by, such as creation date or token value. Controls the sorting criteria for the query.

ITodoAppRole.ICreate.description: Create DTO for todo_app_roles table representing user roles in the todoApp system. Used for authenticated role creation through the POST /todoApp/user/roles endpoint.

name.description: Unique name of the role within the todoApp system, used for access control and permission assignment. Must be unique and non-empty.

description.description: Descriptive text explaining the purpose and responsibilities of the role within the todoApp system. Aids administrators in role management.

ITodoAppRole.IUpdate.description: Request DTO schema for updating an existing role in the todoApp system. Includes only valid fields from the todo_app_roles database table allowing partial updates. Excludes relations and system-managed fields not modifiable by clients.

id.description: Unique identifier of the role in UUID format. Not typically modifiable via update, but present for reference.

name.description: The display name of the role, used in administrative interfaces. Can be updated to rename the role.

description.description: A detailed explanation of the role's purpose and permissions within the system.

created_at.description: Timestamp of role creation. Set by the system, not usually changed by updates.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the role. Set by the system during updates.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the role was soft deleted. Null if active. Managed by the system.

ITodoAppUserRole.description:
User role assignment entity in the todoApp system representing the association between a user and a role. This entity determines permissions and access levels granted to users based on their assigned roles.

It is based on the todo_app_user_roles database table, faithfully mapping all relevant fields, and transforming foreign keys to user and role summary objects to provide comprehensive contextual information.

Used in user role management API operations to assign, retrieve, update, and list roles assigned to users.

Security considerations exclude accepting user identity from client requests, as the user's identity is injected from authentication context.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user role assignment.

user.description: Reference to the user to whom this role assignment belongs. Provides summary information about the user.

role.description: Reference to the role assigned to the user. Provides details about permissions and role attributes.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the user role assignment was created. Null if unknown or not set.

updated_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the user role assignment was last updated. Null if unknown or not set.

ITodoAppAccessToken.ISummary.description: Summary representation of an access token within the todoApp system emphasizing key identifiers, related user context, token lifecycle timestamps, and status for auditing and management purposes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the access token record.

user.description: Reference to the user associated with this access token, providing contextual user information for authorization and auditing.

token.description: The actual token string, securely stored but typically excluded from summary views to maintain security.

type.description: The type of access token, indicating its purpose and usage scope (e.g., Bearer, Refresh).

issued_at.description: Timestamp when the token was issued, used to verify token validity periods.

expired_at.description: Expiration timestamp of the token. Null indicates no expiration or indefinite validity.

revoked_at.description: Timestamp when the token was revoked, if applicable. Null if still valid.

created_at.description: Record creation timestamp, indicating when this access token entry was created.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp for this access token record.

todo_app_user_id.description: UUID of the associated user account, nullable if token belongs to a guest or other entity.

todo_app_guest_id.description: UUID of the guest account linked to this token, nullable if token is for a registered user or session.

todo_app_user_session_id.description: UUID of the user session related to this access token. Nullable if not session-bound.

guest.description: Reference to the guest associated with this access token for context and authorization.

userSession.description: Reference to the user session linked with this token for auditing and contextual awareness.

ITodoAppUserEmailVerification.IUpdate.description: Update request DTO for user email verification records in the todoApp system. Allows modification of mutable fields such as token, expiration time, and verification timestamp but excludes system-managed immutable identifiers and user identity. Adheres strictly to the database schema to prevent unauthorized updates.

tokenExpiredAt.description: When the verification token expires. Nullable to represent no expiration.

verifiedAt.description: Timestamp when the user's email was verified. Null if not verified yet.

deletedAt.description: Record deletion timestamp, marking soft deletion. Null if not deleted.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp, set by the system.

token.description: Verification token used to confirm the user's email address.
The unique verification token generated to validate ownership of the email address. Used in the verification process to confirm that the user owns the email.

token_expired_at.description: The timestamp indicating the expiration time of the verification token. After this time, the token is no longer valid.

verified_at.description: The timestamp when the email was successfully verified. Initially null until verification occurs.

ITodoAppUserEmailVerification.ICreate.description: Request DTO for creating a new user email verification record. This request is used by an authenticated user to initiate email verification without specifying the user identity explicitly, which is inferred from the authentication context.

ITodoAppUserPasswordReset.description:
The user password reset entity represents password reset tokens issued to users, tracking token value, expiration, usage, and related metadata.

This entity maps directly to the todo_app_user_password_resets table in the database and facilitates password recovery workflows by securely managing reset tokens and enforcing expiration and usage rules.

id.description: Unique identifier for the password reset record.

todo_app_user_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user requesting the password reset.

token.description: Secure token generated for password reset verification.

expires_at.description: Expiration timestamp indicating when the reset token becomes invalid. Null means no expiration is set.

requested_at.description: Timestamp marking when the password reset was requested. Null means the request has not been made yet.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the password reset record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the password reset record was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the password reset record was deleted, if applicable. Null means the record is active.

ITodoAppUserRole.IUpdate.description: Request DTO for updating a user role in the todo_app_user_roles table. Allows partial updates to modifiable fields of the user role linked to a specific user. The userId and userRoleId parameters are path parameters and must not be included in the request body. Fields identifying the authenticated user are excluded as they are injected by the authorization context.

todo_app_role_id.description: Unique identifier of the role assigned. Represents the permission group linked to the user in the system.

ITodoAppUserRole.ICreate.description: Request DTO for creating a new user role association in the todoApp system. This DTO is used to assign a specified role to a user, identified externally via the userId path parameter in the API endpoint.

todo_app_role_id.description: Foreign key referencing the unique identifier of the role to be assigned to the user. This determines the permissions and access level of the user.

ITodoAppUserRole.IRequest.description: Request DTO for updating roles assigned to a specific user in the TodoApp system. The user is identified by the path parameter and the authenticated context. This DTO specifies role assignments by their IDs without allowing user ID changes to prevent impersonation and maintain security.

todo_app_role_id.description: Identifier of the role to be assigned or revoked for the user. Must correspond to a valid role in the system.

ITodoAppRefreshToken.IUpdate.description: Request DTO for partially updating properties of a refresh token entity in todoApp. The properties allowed to be updated include the token expiration time and the associated user session. Immutable identifiers and ownership fields are excluded to enforce secure update operations.

expired_at.description: Expiration timestamp after which the refresh token is no longer valid. Nullable if no expiration is set.

user_session_id.description: Identifier of the user session associated with the refresh token. Nullable if the token is not associated with any session.

ITodoAppUserPasswordReset.ISummary.description:
Summary view of a password reset request in the todoApp system.

This DTO represents a summarized form of the password reset token information including identifiers, status, and timestamps relevant for account recovery management. It includes a reference to the associated user summary.

This summary excludes sensitive password data but provides enough information for administrative and user-facing recovery workflows.

id.description: Unique identifier for the password reset entry.

token.description: Token string used to validate the password reset request.

requested_at.description: Timestamp when the reset request was made. Null if unknown.

expires_at.description: Expiration timestamp after which the reset token is invalid.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the reset request record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the reset token was used or last updated. Null if never used.

todoAppUser.description: Summary information of the user who requested the password reset.

ITodoAppTodoItem.description: Todo item entity stored in the todo_app_todo_items table. Represents a task created and owned by an authenticated user. Contains title, description, status, timestamps for creation, update, and optional deletion. The todo item is associated with the owning user and audit logs of changes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the todo item.

title.description: Title of the todo item representing the task summary or name.

description.description: Detailed description or notes for the todo item. Can be null if no description is provided.

status.description: Current status of the todo item indicating its progress stage.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the todo item was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to the todo item, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the todo item was deleted for soft delete. Null if the item is active.

todo_app_user_id.description: Identifier of the user who owns this todo item. Derived from authenticated user's context.

user.description: Reference to the user who owns this todo item. Transforms the user ID foreign key to the user summary object.

auditLogs.description: Audit logs recording creation, update, and deletion actions on the todo item.

ITodoAppUser.description: User entity representing registered users within the todoApp system, storing personal details and secure authentication data. It maps directly to the todo_app_users table and is utilized in user retrieval and update operations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user record in UUID format.

email.description: Email address of the user used for login and communication.

username.description: Username selected by the user for personalized identification.

created_at.description: Timestamp marking when the user was created in the system, following ISO 8601 standards.

updated_at.description: Timestamp indicating the last update time of the user record. Null means no updates have occurred since creation.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp marking when the user was soft-deleted. Null indicates the user is active.

accessTokens.description: List of access tokens issued to the user for authentication and session management.

refreshTokens.description: List of refresh tokens associated with the user enabling session renewal.

emailVerifications.description: Records of email verification attempts and statuses linked to the user.

userPasswordResets.description: Password reset requests submitted by the user for account recovery.

userRoles.description: User roles assigned defining access permissions within the application.

sessions.description: Active and historical user sessions tracking authentication state and device information.

todoItems.description: Collection of todo items created and owned exclusively by the user.

auditLogs.description: Audit log entries recording create, update, and delete actions performed by the user on todo items.

ITodoAppTodoItem.IRequest.description: Search and pagination parameters for filtering the authenticated user's todo items in the todoApp. Allows filtering by various criteria such as status, priority, due dates, and keyword search, with pagination controls to limit result size and navigate pages. This request schema does not include user identity, which is instead provided by the authenticated session context.

status.description: Filter todo items by their status, such as 'pending', 'completed', or 'canceled'.

priority.description: Filter todo items based on their priority level, like 'low', 'medium', or 'high'.

dueDateFrom.description: Filter to include only todo items with due dates on or after this date-time. This parameter supports ISO 8601 date-time format and is optional.

dueDateTo.description: Filter to include only todo items with due dates on or before this date-time. This parameter supports ISO 8601 date-time format and is optional.

search.description: Keyword search filter to match todo item titles or descriptions containing the given search term.

page.description: Pagination page number to retrieve. Defaults to the first page if not specified.

limit.description: Number of todo items to return per page. Helps control result set size for pagination.

sortBy.description: Field by which to sort the todo items. Common fields include 'dueDate', 'priority', or 'creationDate'.

ITodoAppTodoItem.IUpdate.description: Request DTO for updating a todo item within todo_app_todo_items. Allows partial update of description (task details) and status (completion flag). Id, user_id, and timestamps are excluded as they are managed by the system or passed via path/authorization context.

description.description: The content or detailed description of the todo item that the user wants to update. Users can modify this field to change the task details.

status.description: The current completion status of the todo item. This field indicates whether the todo item is marked as done or pending.

ITodoAppUserPasswordReset.ICreate.description: Request DTO for creating a password reset request record in the todo_app_user_password_resets table. This DTO includes the user identifier to associate with the reset request and enables the backend to generate reset tokens and expiration timestamps securely.

todo_app_user_id.description: Unique identifier of the user requesting the password reset. This field links the request to the corresponding user account in the system.

ITodoAppUserEmailVerification.ISummary.description:
Summary view of a user email verification record in the todoApp system.

Represents key information about a user's email verification attempt, including status token, expiration, verification timestamp, and associated user reference.

Used in paginated list responses to enable clients to display concise verification records securely and efficiently.

id.description: Unique identifier of the email verification record.

user_id.description: Identifier of the user to whom this email verification belongs.

token.description: Unique token sent to the user's email address for verification purposes.

token_expired_at.description: Expiration timestamp of the verification token. After this time, the token is invalid for verification.

verified_at.description: Timestamp when the email was successfully verified. Null if not yet verified.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the email verification record was created.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp indicating if and when the record was soft-deleted. Null if the record is active.

ITodoAppUserSession.IRequest.description: Request parameters for searching and paginating user sessions in the todoApp system. Supports filtering by session status, creation and expiration dates, IP addresses, and user agent strings, along with pagination controls for scalable querying.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. This value must be a positive integer starting from 1. Pagination enables clients to retrieve session data in manageable chunks for performance and usability.

pageSize.description: Number of records to return per page in paginated results. This value must be a positive integer and helps control the volume of data transferred in a single response.

status.description: Status of the user session, used to filter active or inactive sessions based on session lifecycle states such as 'active', 'expired', or 'revoked'.

createdFrom.description: Filter sessions created on or after this timestamp. The timestamp must be in ISO 8601 date-time format. Enables retrieval of sessions starting from a specific creation date.

createdTo.description: Filter sessions created before or on this timestamp. The timestamp must be in ISO 8601 date-time format. Enables retrieval of sessions up to a specific creation date.

expired.description: Filters sessions based on their expiration state. When true, only expired sessions are returned; when false, only active sessions are returned.

lastUpdatedFrom.description: Filter sessions updated on or after this timestamp. Useful for retrieving sessions with recent activity. Must be a valid ISO 8601 date-time string.

lastUpdatedTo.description: Filter sessions updated before or on this timestamp. Useful for retrieving sessions no longer recently updated. Must be a valid ISO 8601 date-time string.

ip.description: Filter sessions matching the specified client IP address. Useful for security monitoring and detecting session origin. IP should be in IPv4 or IPv6 format.

userAgent.description: Filter sessions where the client's user agent string matches this value, enabling filtering by browser or device type.

title.description: The title of the todo item. This is a required field representing the task name or summary.

description.description: Detailed description or notes for the todo item. Optional field that can be null if no description is provided.

oneOf.description: Status of the todo item indicating its current state, such as pending, done, or cancelled.
Status of the todo item indicating its current state, such as pending, done, or cancelled.
Status of the todo item indicating its current state, such as pending, done, or cancelled.

status.description: Status of the todo item indicating its current state, such as pending, done, or cancelled.

ITodoAppTodoItem.ICreate.description: Request DTO for creating a new todo item in the todo_app_todo_items table. User identity is derived from the authenticated session and user ID fields are excluded for security reasons. This schema includes fields for title, optional description, and completion status represented by status.

ITodoAppUser.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for filtering and paginating todoApp users. This DTO is used as the request body in PATCH /todoApp/user/users to specify search criteria such as username, email, status, and registration date range, along with pagination controls.

This type does not map to any database table, being a request parameter object representing search filters.

All fields are optional to allow flexible filtering and querying. The pagination parameters 'page' and 'limit' support common offset-style paging.

Security: No sensitive or authentication fields are included. The authenticated user's identity is derived from the token and not specified here.

username.description: Optional filter to search users by their username or display name.

email.description: Optional filter to search users by their email address.

status.description: Optional filter for user account status such as 'active', 'inactive', or 'banned'.

createdAtStart.description: Optional filter for the registration date start range, to find users created on or after this timestamp.

createdAtEnd.description: Optional filter for the registration date end range, to find users created on or before this timestamp.

page.description: Optional pagination parameter specifying the current page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

limit.description: Optional pagination parameter specifying the maximum number of users per page. Limits the size of the returned user list for performance.

ITodoAppUserSession.ISummary.description: Summary view of user sessions in the todoApp system, representing essential metadata of active or inactive sessions associated with authenticated users.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user session record.

user.description: Summary information of the user associated with this session. This replaces the raw todo_app_user_id foreign key for richer context.

ip.description: IP address from which the session was initiated. Used for security monitoring and audit trails.

href.description: The URL from which the session originated, capturing the client-side page location when the session was established.

referrer.description: The referrer URL indicating the previous page before the session was established, useful for tracking user navigation paths.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the session was created.

expiredAt.description: Timestamp when this session is set to expire. Sessions beyond this point are invalid and require re-authentication.

accessTokens.description: List of access tokens issued for this session, representing the authentication credentials used.

refreshTokens.description: List of refresh tokens associated with this session to maintain long-term authentication securely.

ITodoAppUserSession.description: User session entity containing authentication data and metadata for the todoApp system user sessions stored in the todo_app_user_sessions table. This entity tracks session lifecycle, ownership, and security tokens for managing logged-in user sessions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user session record in the todo_app_user_sessions table, generated as a UUID.

accessTokens.description: JWT access token issued to authenticate API requests during the session. Used for authorization and securing resource access.

refreshTokens.description: Refresh token issued to renew the access token without requiring user re-authentication. Enables long-lived sessions securely.

expired_at.description: Datetime when this session expires. Null if the session does not expire or is indefinitely valid.

created_at.description: Timestamp recording when the session was created. Managed by the system for auditing and session lifecycle tracking.

expired_at_updated_at.description: Timestamp recording the last time the session record was updated. Nullable for initial creations before updates.

ip.description: IP address from which the session was initiated or last used. Nullable to handle cases where IP info is unavailable.

href.description: HTTP User-Agent string from the client device or browser that initiated the session. Nullable if not recorded.

todoAppUser.description: Associated user entity to whom this session belongs. Provides user identification and summary information.

ITodoAppUser.ISummary.description: Summary view of a registered user in the todoApp system. Provides essential identification and profile information suitable for lists and embedded references. Sensitive authentication information is excluded. This view supports pagination and filtering operations to efficiently handle large user sets.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user in the todoApp system, generated as a UUID.

email.description: Registered email address of the user used for identification and communication. This is unique across the system.

username.description: The user's chosen username for display and login purposes. It is unique and immutable after registration.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created. This follows the ISO 8601 standard for date and time.

updated_at.description: Timestamp indicating the last time the user account was updated. If the user has never been updated post-creation, this field may be null. This also follows ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was deleted or deactivated. This field may be null if the user is active. Utilized for soft deletion logic.

ITodoAppTodoItem.ISummary.description:
Summary view of a Todo item entity showing essential fields used in lists and basic display within the todoApp system.

This summary includes identifiers, title, status, related user information, creation and update timestamps, and audit logs for tracking changes.

It omits detailed fields for brevity and is suitable for paginated list responses where full todo item details are not necessary.

Mapping corresponds directly to the todo_app_todo_items database table, exposing relevant columns and relationships with associated entities for enriched context.

The structure is designed for read-only operations, ensuring complete data presence with nullable fields handled appropriately for correct API client interpretation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Todo item, generated by the system.

title.description: Title or short description of the Todo item representing the task to be done.

description.description: Detailed description of the Todo item. May be null if no details provided.

status.description: Current status of the Todo item indicating its progress stage.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the Todo item was created in the system.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent update made to the Todo item.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp marking when the Todo item was deleted. Null if not deleted.

user.description: The user who owns this Todo item. Contains summary information of the user.

auditLogs.description: List of audit logs related to changes made to this Todo item, tracking creation, updates, and deletions for compliance and history.

ITodoAppTodoItemAuditLog.IRequest.description: Request DTO for filtering and paginating todo item audit logs. Allows specifying search criteria including the audit log ID, related todo item, action type, changed data content, user who performed the action, as well as creation time range filters and pagination options. Supports precise and efficient querying of audit trails for todo items.

id.description: Unique identifier of the todo item audit log entry.

todo_app_todo_item_id.description: Foreign key referencing the todo item associated with this audit log entry.

action.description: Action performed on the todo item, such as create, update, or delete.

changed_data.description: JSON string detailing the specific data changes made during the action.

todo_app_user_id.description: Identifier of the user who performed the change recorded by this audit log entry.

created_at_from.description: Start of creation time filter, inclusive. Filters audit logs created at or after this timestamp.

created_at_to.description: End of creation time filter, exclusive. Filters audit logs created before this timestamp.

page.description: Page number for pagination of audit log results. Starts from 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of audit log records to return per page for pagination.

ITodoAppUserPasswordReset.IUpdate.description: Data Transfer Object for updating todo_app_user_password_resets entries. Allows partial update of token, expiration, request and system timestamps. Ownership and identity fields are managed via authentication and URL path parameters, and thus not included in this DTO.

token.description: Unique token string used for password reset authentication. Validated on use to secure password reset process.

expires_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the reset token expires. After this time, the token is invalid.

requested_at.description: Timestamp when the password reset was originally requested. Used for auditing and token validity checks.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp of the password reset record, useful for audit trails and historical references.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the password reset record, supporting record modification tracking.

deleted_at.description: Optional deletion timestamp indicating soft-deleted records, enabling logical removal without physical delete.

ITodoAppTodoItemAuditLog.ISummary.description:
Summary DTO representing a single audit log entry for a todo item, used in paginated list responses. This provides essential audit information about actions performed on todo items including who performed the action, what action was taken, and when. It ensures accountability and traceability within the todoApp system while exposing only safe and relevant fields.

Audit log entries capture change history and event details, supporting user and admin insights.

This type maps directly to the todo_app_todo_item_audit_logs table in the database.

id.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry.

todo_app_todo_item_id.description: Identifier of the todo item associated with this audit log entry.

user.description: Reference to the user who performed the action, providing user context without exposing sensitive data.

action.description: Type of action performed on the todo item (e.g., create, update, delete). Enumerates the nature of the logged event for auditing purposes.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the action occurred. Recorded in ISO 8601 format for consistency and timezone standardization.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the audit log entry was last updated, if applicable. Null if never updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the audit log entry was deleted, if applicable. Null if not deleted.

ITodoAppUser.IUpdate.description: User update request DTO for modifying user account details in todoApp. This DTO allows authenticated users to update their profile and account information. All fields are optional to support partial updates. Sensitive fields such as password hashes and authentication tokens are excluded. System-managed fields like identifiers and timestamps are not required in the update payload.

email.description: User's email address used for login and notifications. Must be unique and follow email format.

username.description: Username used by the user to log in and identify themselves within the system.

bio.description: User biography or profile description. Nullable field that can be cleared by sending null.

expired_at.description: Timestamp when the user account expires or becomes inactive. Nullable to represent active accounts with no expiration.

avatar_url.description: URL of the user's avatar image. Nullable to remove avatar.

ITodoAppGuest.ISummary.description:
Summary information of a guest user in the Todo application system.

Represents a concise view of guest user data for list displays and references. Includes the guest's unique identifier and audit timestamps. Sensitive information like email or phone numbers are not stored in the database and thus not included.

Used primarily in API responses for paginated guest listings and selection widgets.

id.description: Unique identifier for the guest user record in the system. This serves as the primary key in the todo_app_guests database table.

guest_identifier.description: The unique identifier code assigned to the guest user for identification and reference within the system.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the guest user record was created in the system. Stored in ISO 8601 date-time format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to the guest user's record. May be null if no updates have occurred since creation. Stored in ISO 8601 date-time format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the guest user was soft-deleted. Null if the guest user is active. Stored in ISO 8601 date-time format.

ITodoAppRefreshToken.description:
Represents a refresh token entity within the todoApp system, managing user authentication sessions with token values, associations to users and sessions, creation and expiration timestamps.

This entity is key for authentication token refresh operations, ensuring secure session continuation and token lifecycle management.

Includes identifiers, token string, timestamps, and foreign key relations to user and user session entities.

Used in API operations for creating, refreshing, and managing refresh tokens securely.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) for the refresh token record.

refresh_token.description: Unique string value representing the refresh token itself, used for authenticating continued user or guest sessions.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the refresh token was initially created.

expired_at.description: Timestamp when the refresh token expires and is no longer valid.

user.description: Summary of the user associated with this refresh token.

userSession.description: Summary of the user session associated with this refresh token.

ITodoAppTodoItemAuditLog.description:
Audit log entry for a todo item recording the details of create, update, and delete actions within the todoApp system.

Each log entry captures the user who performed the action, the timestamp when the action occurred, the type of operation performed, and a snapshot of the todo item data at that time.

This entity maps directly to the todo_app_todo_item_audit_logs database table and is used in authorized read operations for audit and compliance tracking.

All fields are included as present in the database schema with appropriate handling of foreign key relations and timestamp aliasing.

id.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry.

todoItem.description: Summary of the todo item related to this audit log entry. Represents the todo_app_todo_items entity referenced by this log.

action.description: Type of audit action performed (create, update, or delete) on the todo item.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this audit action was recorded, in ISO 8601 format with timezone.

user.description: User who performed the action logged in this audit entry. Reference to the user entity summary.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when this audit log was marked deleted, or null if not deleted. Used for soft deletion tracking.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this audit log was last updated, or null if never updated.

IPageITodoAppGuestSession.ISummary.description:
A page.

Collection of records with pagination information.

ITodoAppGuestSession.IRequest.description: Search and pagination parameters for filtering guest sessions associated with a specific guest user in the todoApp system. This request DTO is used in the PATCH /todoApp/guest/guests/{guestId}/sessions operation to provide flexible filtering, sorting, and pagination capabilities for retrieving guest session data securely and efficiently.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Starts from 1.

limit.description: Number of items per page for pagination. Typical range is 10 to 50.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort the results by. Typically a timestamp or status field.

oneOf.description: Sort order for the results. Either 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending.
Sort order for the results. Either 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending.

sortOrder.description: Sort order for the results. Either 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending.

createdBefore.description: Filter sessions created before this timestamp (ISO 8601 format).

createdAfter.description: Filter sessions created after this timestamp (ISO 8601 format).

expiredBefore.description: Filter sessions that expire before this timestamp (ISO 8601 format).

expiredAfter.description: Filter sessions that expire after this timestamp (ISO 8601 format).

status.description: Status of the session for filtering. Possible values include active, expired, or revoked, reflecting session lifecycle state.

ITodoAppGuestSession.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a guest session record in the todo_app_guest_sessions table.

This DTO provides essential session information for guest users in the todoApp system, suitable for listing in paginated API responses.

Sensitive authentication data is excluded for security.

All fields correspond to the underlying database columns, with appropriate typing and documentation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the guest session record.

guest_id.description: Identifier of the guest user associated with the session.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the guest session was created.

href.description: URI of the website or application endpoint where the guest session originated or was last active. Null if unknown.

referrer.description: Referrer URL indicating the previous webpage or source from which the session originated. Null if unavailable.

ip.description: IP address from which the guest session was initiated or last used. May be null if not recorded.

expired_at.description: Timestamp when the guest session expires and becomes invalid. Null if session does not expire.

ITodoAppGuestSession.ICreate.description: Request DTO for creating a new guest session in TodoApp. Represents necessary data for session creation including mandatory access and refresh tokens, expiration timestamp, and optional client metadata. Does not include system-generated or path parameter fields such as guestId or session id.

accessToken.description: Access token issued to the guest session for authenticating guest requests.

refreshToken.description: Refresh token allowing session renewal without re-authentication.

ip.description: Optional IP address of the client initiating the session for audit and security purposes. Nullable if not provided.

userAgent.description: Optional HTTP user-agent string of the client device for session context and monitoring. Nullable if omitted.

deviceInfo.description: Optional device metadata string supplied during session creation providing additional context. Nullable if absent.

expiresAt.description: Expiration timestamp of the access token in ISO 8601 format indicating session expiry.

ITodoAppGuestSession.IUpdate.description: Request DTO for updating a guest session record in the todoApp system. Excludes system-generated and authentication-injected fields such as guest_id and id. Contains the session properties that a guest is permitted to update.

ip.description: IP address of the guest during the session. Nullable for anonymity or privacy concerns.

href.description: URL currently being viewed by the guest during the session. Used for analytics and session context.

referrer.description: Referrer URL the guest followed to reach the current page. Useful for analytics and tracking.

expired_at.description: Timestamp when the guest session expires. Null if session never expires.

ITodoAppGuestSession.description: This schema defines the guest session entity in the todoApp system, which tracks authentication sessions associated with guest users. The entity includes essential session identifiers, IP address, page URLs for user navigation context, creation and expiration timestamps, and a reference to the owning guest user. It maps directly to the todo_app_guest_sessions database table and is used in API operations for managing guest sessions securely and efficiently.

id.description: Unique identifier for the guest session record. This ID is assigned upon session creation and uniquely identifies the session in the database.

guest_id.description: Identifier of the guest user who owns this session. This foreign key establishes the ownership link between the session and the guest user.

ip.description: IP address from which the guest session was initiated or last active, used for security tracking and analytics.

href.description: URL of the page associated with this session, representing the navigation context where the session was established or last active.

referrer.description: URL of the referring page prior to the current session's navigation point, used for understanding traffic sources and user behavior.

created_at.description: Timestamp recording the exact moment when this guest session was created. This is essential for auditing and session lifecycle management.

expired_at.description: Timestamp indicating when this session is set to expire. A null value means the session has no predefined expiration and remains valid until explicitly terminated.

ITodoAppRefreshToken.ISummary.description:
Summary view of a refresh token entity within the todoApp system, representing essential attributes required for authentication session renewal and management.

This type maps directly to the 'todo_app_refresh_tokens' database table and includes the unique identifier of the token, the token string itself, the user it is associated with, expiration details, creation time, and revocation state.

Used in responses where refresh token details are needed without exposing sensitive internal token storage or full user credentials.

ITodoAppUserRole.ISummary.description: Summary view of a user role assignment entity in the todoApp system. Represents the basic identifying and descriptive information of a user's assigned role for use in user lists and role management. This schema maps to the 'todo_app_user_roles' database table and includes the primary key, role code, an optional role name for display, and timestamps for creation and update tracking.
